resources.string: Point your camera at the QR code that rafiq-bridge pair or rafiq-bridge setup printed on your server.
That QR code is not a Rafiq pairing code. Scan the one rafiq-bridge pair printed.
The camera could not start. Type the address and code instead.
Rafiq uses the camera only to scan the pairing code. You can type the address and code instead.
Check that this is your server, then tap Connect:
This is not a Tailscale name (ending in .ts.net), which tailscale serve gives your server. Connect only if you know this server is yours.
This phone is already paired. To pair it with a server again, unpair it in Settings first.
